scope: The five r69 P1/228 caffe-cifar-10 requests only. Per-rank Attention candidates within each original batch, original private state objects, fixed offers, EOS, routes, group membership and dispatch. No cross-rank sharing. D decode is replayed after the P resource change.
wire_model: Use native API intervals to anchor a service profile and infer bytes per port from MAC proportions, flattening enough to stay below each nominal cap. Reallocate each port's reconstructed native service among active calls while holding other observed costs; use the fitted port peak only in native idle periods. Protocol traffic and other resource waits are not identifiable below the polling cadence. Per-flow headroom and per-call port shares are assumptions, not packet evidence.
